summary.text: Melanie Sachs is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 102, Cumberland County, representing Freeport.
The page lists Melanie Sachs as chair of the Energy, Utilities and Technology committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Melanie Sachs's education as Bates College, Case Western Reserve University (BA Political Science, MSSA, 1991, 1994).
The page lists Melanie Sachs's occupation as Social Work.
Listed affiliations include Freeport town council,Council chair/ vice chair.
Melanie Sachs lives in Freeport and has served 3 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Committee assignments listed: Energy, Utilities and Technology (chair).
Family details on the page: married, spouse Andrew, 2 children.
